name: asymptomatik-souvenir
description: Search and browse past Claude Code conversation transcripts with text and semantic search

embedding_provider.title: Embedding provider
embedding_provider.description: Service that turns text into vectors for semantic search. "ollama": a local Ollama server (default, nothing leaves your machine). "openai": any OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings API (OpenAI, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp server, Ollama's /v1...). Changing the provider or model requires rebuilding the index.

embedding_url.title: Embedding server URL
embedding_url.description: Leave empty for the provider default: http://localhost:11434 for ollama, https://api.openai.com/v1 for openai. For another OpenAI-compatible server, give its base URL ending in /v1 (e.g. http://localhost:1234/v1).

embedding_model.title: Embedding model
embedding_model.description: Leave empty for the provider default: embeddinggemma for ollama, text-embedding-3-small for openai. With ollama, the model is pulled automatically if missing.

embedding_dimensions.title: Embedding dimensions
embedding_dimensions.description: Leave empty to use the model's native size (detected automatically). Set it only to shorten vectors on models that support it (OpenAI text-embedding-3, Matryoshka models).

embedding_api_key.title: Embedding API key
embedding_api_key.description: Only for the openai provider when the server requires a key (OpenAI, hosted APIs). Local servers usually need none. Stored in your system's secure storage.

db_path.title: Transcript index database
db_path.description: Absolute path of the SQLite file holding the transcript index. Leave empty for the default: ~/.claude/ASymptOmatik/souvenir/souvenir.db (inside your Claude config directory).
